corpus_policy: Synthetic labels only; disjoint project/session groups for tune and heldout.
tuning_note: Before heldout evaluation, include the documented Windows Search content-match tier (20); fuzzy-only tiers 15/18 stay below the floor. Literal query/metadata agreement remains required.
model_sampling: One prespecified ambiguous/task-switch/multilingual/adversarial case per project, stratified before heldout evaluation.
